title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: duplicate definitions cause 43 compile errors in lib.rs and vectors.rs
description: The commit added duplicate definitions of context_at (vectors.rs:105,126), TestStore, TestProtect, for_context, test_request_protection_vectors, and test_response_protection_vectors. These collide with existing definitions already present in the codebase, causing 43 compilation errors. Also: calls to nonexistent Context::load_existing, Context::new called with wrong arity (4 vs 5), Context::protect_request doesn't exist on the public API, protect_response calls missing the new include_piv bool parameter, and various type mismatches (u32 vs u64, Option unwrapping, borrow-after-move).
